description: Source code for the BCM43XX Bluetooth driver implementation, including class definition, configuration, initialization, firmware loading, and external C interface functions.

classes.name: Broadcom43XX
classes.description: Bluetooth driver class for Broadcom BCM43XX chips, handling firmware, MAC address, and communication setup.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration class for BCM43XX driver, holding serial port, firmware path, baud rate, MAC address, and setup options.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Bluetooth device, resets, loads firmware, and sets MAC address.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Sends reset command to the device.

methods.name: FindFirmware
methods.description: Recursively searches for firmware files matching chip name.

methods.name: LoadName
methods.description: Reads the local name of the Bluetooth device.

methods.name: SetClock
methods.description: Sets the clock speed of the device.

methods.name: SetSpeed
methods.description: Sets the baud rate of the device.

methods.name: MACAddress
methods.description: Sets the MAC address of the device.

methods.name: Firmware
methods.description: Loads firmware into the device from specified directory.

methods.name: GetDeviceMAC
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address from system adapters.
